meta.title: Nearshore Snowflake engineers in Monterrey
meta.description: Nearshore Snowflake team: SnowPro-certified data and AI engineers working US Central hours from our delivery center in Monterrey, Mexico, across the USA and LATAM.

hero.title: A nearshore Snowflake team, <hl>in sync with yours</hl>.
hero.description: SnowPro-certified Snowflake experts who work the same business hours. Delivery moves at the pace of a team down the hall, not a handoff that waits overnight.
hero.clocksNote: The team works your business hours year round. Monterrey holds Central Standard Time (CST) all year, so when US Central moves to CDT from March to November the clock here sits an hour behind: the working day still overlaps end to end and nothing waits overnight.

trust.eyebrow: Trusted by teams across the USA and LATAM

reasonsHeading.title: Deep Snowflake delivery, without the offshore tradeoffs
reasonsHeading.intro: Nearshore delivery is data and AI work built from a nearby country on the client's business hours, close enough that a blocker raised in the morning is resolved the same day instead of overnight. Nearshore brings the cost and capacity advantages of a distributed team while keeping the proximity, hours, and communication of one in the building.

reasons.label: Depth
reasons.title: Snowflake depth at every level
reasons.body: Strategists, architects, and SnowPro-certified engineers, all fluent in Snowflake. The depth that scopes the work is the depth that delivers it.

reasons.label: Language
reasons.title: Clear, bilingual communication
reasons.body: A fully English- and Spanish-proficient team and direct access to the people doing the work. Fewer translation layers, fewer misread requirements.

reasons.label: Continuity
reasons.title: The same team from scope to run
reasons.body: A committed team learns the data and the goals and stays on: no re-staffing mid-engagement, no delivery pyramid billed by the hour.

reasons.label: Cadence
reasons.title: A communication cadence to count on
reasons.body: Regular working sessions and full visibility into progress. No one is ever in the dark on where a build stands or what comes next.

reasons.label: Delivery
reasons.title: Agile delivery, value early
reasons.body: An iterative, use-case-driven model that puts working data products in front of the team in weeks, then builds on what proves out.

proximity.title: Close enough to be <hl>in the room</hl>
proximity.body: Monterrey sits about 140 miles from the Texas border, the industrial anchor of the corridor the United States and Mexico trade across under USMCA. Nonstop flights from Monterrey International Airport (MTY) reach major US cities in one to four hours, so an onsite workshop costs a morning of travel instead of a two-day trip. Most weeks it never comes up, because the working day already overlaps end to end.
bullets: Nonstop flights to major US cities in one to four hours
Central Time all year, so mornings start together and answers land same-day
Onsite when it counts: discovery workshops and steering reviews in your office
Bilingual by default, in English or Spanish, whichever the room thinks in

deliverHeading.title: The full data & AI build, delivered nearshore
deliverHeading.intro: Our delivery team works from Monterrey, Mexico, on Central Time and your business hours, covering the same scope Viewnear delivers anywhere: from migration to governed AI in production.

delivers.title: Data modernization and migration
delivers.body: Legacy warehouses and pipelines consolidated onto Snowflake, governed from the first table.

delivers.title: AI and Cortex
delivers.body: Governed, AI-ready data and Cortex use cases prioritized against real business return.

delivers.title: Governance and Horizon
delivers.body: Access, lineage, and policy built in with Horizon, so trust scales with the data.

delivers.title: Data apps and Snowpark
delivers.body: Native data applications and Snowpark workloads that run where the data already lives.

team.title: Nearshore should not mean <hl>junior</hl>
team.body: The Monterrey team holds SnowPro certifications and is proven in production. The people who scope the work are the people who build it, and they specialize in exactly one platform: Snowflake, every project, every day.
bullets: SnowPro-certified architects and engineers, proven in production
A rigorous hiring bar for every team member
Direct access to the engineers doing the work
